observationMethod: Manual visible roof-edge interpretation on native 2024-06-27 RGB pixels. Roof outlines are not ground wall footprints; shadow, tree cover and relief displacement remain unresolved.
pixelConvention: Continuous image coordinates from upper-left pixel edge; EPSG position E=minE+u*0.16, N=maxN-v*0.16.

roofs.label: Main clubhouse roof
roofs.notes: Principal gabled roof envelope including shaded east slope; exact east eave and small north projections remain uncertain. Historical official obliques 34163074006 and 34163073056 corroborate two roof slopes, glazed south gable and lower west roof. Roof has apparent relief displacement; do not snap 2023 laser support to image coordinates. West terrace and lower roof recorded separately; inherited outline reaches paved courtyard to north.
